title: Compliance blob v1
description: Per-client compliance status. sig only for restricting statuses; see fixtures/crypto/compliance-vectors. need_token_update: device deactivated, guest past its expiry, or the device's HA token changed after its last contact with the hub (ha_token_minted_at > last_seen: rotated or remote access switched off while the device was away). The app stops signing in to HA from outside until it is home again (HA IP ban). deleted: pending deletion.

ts.description: Unix seconds. The app does not check its age; a replayed signed status can only repeat a restricting status for the same device (docs/enforcement.md, Compliance status away from home).

then.description: Restricting status: sig expected (omitted only when the secret_hash is unusable - fail neutral).
